command: ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-lock-current.log QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device -netdev user,id=net0 -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=net0,disable-legacy=on' python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-demo-lock
target: AArch64 PCI QEMU, one guest CPU, current desktop ISO
checks: The stock Lock source ran its unlocked and locked increment loops through the graphical terminal on the current ISO.
Both result rows were visibly present in the captured graphical terminal: Correct Count:2000000 Actual Count:2000000.
The terminal accepted 40+2 and returned 0x2A=42 after the demo; zstatus reported failed=0.
scope_note: Partial runtime acceptance only. The guarded ARM64 source overlay maps both nominal worker requests to CPU 0. This verifies serial worker execution and LOCK instruction behavior, not inter-CPU contention or SMP lock correctness. Live UTM and physical Pi behavior are unverified.
